name: Streaming Digital Assets And Digital Inheritance Ab22Adc629
text: Digital Assets and Digital Inheritance states that digital inheritance by law or will can be limited by contract terms and constitutional privacy rights. This supplies succession-specific limits that qualify any uniform application of Kaal's property-style digital-object framework. The abstract does not identify which objects satisfy rivalry or resolve conflicts among license, service, confidentiality, and privacy rules.
